contract: Pure check of tenant settings against a caller-supplied version 1 descriptor (id, revision, input Port, closed-object draft 2020-12 schema, at most 64 secret names) through the ready core/payload-schema; a secret setting is only an exact 1..128-byte ref/scope reference, never resolved. Success returns the original settings; fixed bounds and fixed redacted failures; no defaults, coercion, store or resolver.
limits: Host-approved schema complexity and truthful immutable meaning per (id, revision, version) are host Needs; no digest, registry, timeout or CPU/memory isolation.
A well-shaped reference authenticates nobody and is not checked for existence, authority, expiry or value; credential bytes placed in an identifier are not detected.
Nested property validation and schema semantics are the ready core/payload-schema and pinned JSV; this Piece does not prove them.
Finite listed scenarios, not universal proofs. integration/secrets and telemetry are used by copied tests only, not by the library.

grounding.claim: Listed scenarios of the groups declared_settings_only, secret_reference_not_value, identity_and_ready_schema_reuse and fixed_bounds_and_redacted_failure pass, including the checked example; two temporary production edits are negative controls. Finite scenarios, not a universal proof.
Schema compilation and validation through the ready core/payload-schema build/2 and check/3, reused unchanged.
Default compact JSON encoding supplies the descriptor and settings byte counts after the representation and depth checks.
Pinned Elixir String.valid?/1, byte_size/1 and exact term comparison decide names, identifiers and the reference schema shape.

The host supplies approved schema complexity, immutable truthful identity per (id, revision, version), secret-free nonsecret values and reference identifiers, and later resolves the exact scope under fresh authority. Checked values come from build/1; forged internals are outside the Contract.

telemetry.contract: No logs or telemetry emitted; the caller owns instrumentation.

config.contract: Descriptor and settings are data operands of each call and the bounds are fixed; no ambient settings.

control.contract: No process, lifecycle or settings execution.
